title: Buddy Petit's death and meeting Louis in Washington in 1933
summary: Joe never tracked old Baton Rouge friends and first learned of Buddy Petit's death when he met Louis in 1933 at the Remington ferry through Pops Foster.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Around this time, I would think... I'm just trying to figure when you were on this boat... Somewhere around this time, a lot of the New Orleans guys that we've talked about, like, for instance, Buddy Petit... Buddy Petit died in, I think, 1931. Did you ever hear that those guys had died, or were you conscious of all that...?
No, I never... I never really kept track of those guys then. The first I heard of Buddy Petit dying was when I first met Louis. In 1933 I met Louis on the
Remington Ferry, Remington, Washington. And I think me and Pops Foster... I met him through Pops Foster. I was playing over there with a band, if you want to jump that far.
